programs.showName: Junction Varanasi: Ek Amar Prem Katha
programs.description: Prem sustains a serious injury while saving his brother, Amar, from Sadhucharan. The brothers, who are extremely close, must fight Sadhucharan who is out for revenge.
A young man falls for a woman from the red-light district, but their love faces opposition and threat from powerful figures.
A poet falls in love with a girl and later realises that she is terminally ill. Despite being aware of her condition, he decides to marry her and keep her happy.
Akash, the son of a lawyer, falls in love with a courtesan when he hears her recite one of his poems. However, a series of obstacles and a mysterious murder threaten to break them apart.
Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success.
A woman gets stuck in India when her flight to a foreign country gets delayed. While travelling in India, she meets Tony, a tour guide, and things take a turn when he falls in love with her.
Abhay returns from prison after running over a man and falls for the victim's daughter. However, when her brother sees them in a compromising position, he accuses Abhay of assaulting her.
A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.
Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman.
Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.
Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.
Pandit Girdhari Laal Sharma wants to get his daughter, Radha, married extravagantly but lacks the money for it. He then devises a plan to source the money, unaware of the consequences.
Radhe looks up to Kadak Singh, a local politician, but holds a grudge against his partner, Ram Tripathi. However, things reach a boiling point when Tripathi sets his sights on Radhe's wife, Lalli.

Anshul, an ordinary man, falls in love with Preeti, a politician's daughter. Things take a turn when Preeti's brothers disapprove of the relationship and commit a crime in order to end it.
After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.

Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.
Suspecting an extra-marital affair, Vijay, a professor, abandons his wife, Laxmi. However, years later, when he is hurtled back into Laxmi's life through her adopted daughter, things become clearer.

After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.
Shera hopes to marry Sapna, but is sent to prison for committing a crime. He is released after several months, only to be arrested again, unaware that he and Sapna are mere pawns in a dangerous game.
Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
JD has several problems surrounding his marriage according to his horoscope. Unfortunately, his mother's constant nagging and friends' unwanted relationship advice only makes matters worse.
